items.prompt:
Which direction do we read in English?
A) Right to left
B) Left to right
C) Bottom to top

steps: English reads left to right. Key is B.

items.prompt:
What is between two words?
A) A letter
B) A space
C) A number

steps: Spaces separate words. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Letters come together to make a:
A) Space
B) Word
C) Picture

steps: Letters form words. Key is B.

items.prompt:
After the top line of a page, we read:
A) The bottom line
B) The next line down
C) The same line again

steps: Top to bottom. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Words come together to make a:
A) Letter
B) Sentence
C) Space

steps: Words form sentences. Key is B.

items.prompt:
We begin reading a line at the:
A) Right
B) Left
C) Middle

steps: Start at the left. Key is B.

items.prompt:
How many words are in 'The cat ran'?
A) One
B) Three
C) Nine

steps: Spaces show three words. Key is B.

items.prompt:
A written word on the page stands for a:
A) Picture only
B) Spoken word
C) Number

steps: Print shows speech. Key is B.
